paper: step 8. Provisional Section 3.3. The commons reference evaluation model is a trained artifact.
adr: Training lives under tools/evaluator-training/. This file is the LoRA run: base, hyperparameters, framework pins, seed. The generation recipe is recipe.json. The held-out suite is not an input.

base.note: Read at run time from the manifest. repoId here is a pin that must match. Do not train Qwen3-0.6B-Base.

framework.whyNotUnsloth: 0.6B plus 3936 short examples does not need Unsloth's memory path. The standard stack is the one a reader can follow without a third training runtime.
framework.reportToNote: No cloud metric sink. Loss logs to stdout and artifacts/train-log.json. Trackio would be a Hub side channel this run does not need.
framework.torch: supplied by the GPU image; not pinned here so a CUDA wheel is not overwritten

train.enableThinkingNote: Qwen3 thinking must stay off. Inference uses QwenChatWrapper thoughts=discourage. Training applies enable_thinking=False so the assistant target is the compact verdict line.
train.chatTemplateNote: Stock Qwen3-0.6B template plus {% generation %} around assistant content. TRL assistant_only_loss needs those spans. Rendered text must match stock; train.py refuses to start if it does not, or if the assistant mask is empty. Epochs and learning rate are unchanged in this masking fix.
train.evalDatasetNote: The held-out suite is the final gate, never a training or hyperparameter split. Epochs are fixed. Loss is logged. There is no early stopping.

llamaCpp.note: convert_hf_to_gguf.py then llama-quantize Q8_0. The run records the resolved commit in artifacts.json. Q8_0 matches the live vendor pin's quantization.

time.estimate: Well under two hours on a single 80GB card. 0.6B LoRA, 3936 examples, 3 epochs, sequences around 2k tokens, then merge, llama.cpp convert, and 187 compact-verdict gate items. If a run is still training after 90 minutes, stop and report: that is a hang, not the expected duration.

publish.when: only after gate-report.json pass is true
publish.note: Publication writes a trainedCandidate on the model manifest. It does not replace the live v2.1 vendor GGUF and it does not change the default evaluator.
